title: Lowered latent Inhibition

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: Latent inhibition (LI) is a technical term in classical conditioning, where a familiar stimulus takes longer to acquire meaning (as a signal or conditioned stimulus) than a new stimulus.
wikitext: Latent inhibition (LI) is a technical term in classical conditioning, where a familiar stimulus takes longer to acquire meaning (as a signal or conditioned stimulus) than a new stimulus.[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latent_inhibition]
